svg.title: One passage, two ways to edit it: unbounded polishing and Academic Writing Assistant
svg.desc: An informal synthetic manuscript passage. Unbounded polishing reads more professional but drops the hedges, changes a number and widens the comparison; with Academic Writing Assistant the language becomes just as professional while hedges, numbers and citations stay as written, and the edit explains what changed and what the author should confirm.
